cohort: The study included 825,112 infants admitted to 137 continuously participating NICUs in 29 US states, with a focus on 60,944 extremely preterm infants, including 872 born at 22 weeks' gestation.
finding: An increasing share of resources in US NICUs was allocated to infants born at 22 weeks' gestation between 2008 and 2021, corresponding with changes in national clinical guidance.
gest_age: Extremely preterm infants, specifically 22 weeks' gestation, compared with other extremely preterm infants (<=28 weeks' gestation), and infants born at less than 22 and at 23 weeks.
